    WHEN '18'::text THEN 'department_store'::canonical_sector_key_v3
    WHEN '20'::text THEN 'other'::canonical_sector_key_v3

    WHEN '22'::text THEN 'biotech_medical'::canonical_sector_key_v3
    WHEN '23'::text THEN 'oil_gas_electricity'::canonical_sector_key_v3
    WHEN '24'::text THEN 'semiconductor'::canonical_sector_key_v3
    WHEN '25'::text THEN 'computer_peripheral'::canonical_sector_key_v3
    WHEN '26'::text THEN 'optoelectronics'::canonical_sector_key_v3
    WHEN '27'::text THEN 'communications_network'::canonical_sector_key_v3

    WHEN '29'::text THEN 'electronic_distribution'::canonical_sector_key_v3

    WHEN '31'::text THEN 'other_electronics'::canonical_sector_key_v3
